arms.O: music_structured + deterministic acoustic guidance + repeat rewriting (<=5 groups, vocabulary overlap >=0.20)

config.local_candidates: sol61 v3 K=2 per 5.0625 s window, unchanged

review.protocol: blinded pair, order swapped, actions shown in full (no truncation), theme ids hidden, 4 criteria 1-5
review.aggregation: two-order mean, song-level bootstrap 95% CI, preference consistency reported
review.human: 2 independent reviewers on the same blinded pairs; abstain allowed, never imputed

excluded_claims: any component additivity without a dedicated arm

data_discipline.dev: dev split only; fma-10811 and fma-12099 are test and must not appear in development or tuning
data_discipline.formal: all 11 available songs; dev (5) and test (6) reported separately; no tuning on test

power_estimate: with the observed dev effect (mean +2.75, sd 3.18) 12 songs reach ~92% power
cost_estimate: outer model only: ~25 calls per song; 12 songs x 2 arms = 24 runs, roughly 3-4 hours on two local 30B servers
gate: freeze code sha before dispatch; report every failure as a result, never drop incomplete runs

amended.before: the local corpus contains exactly 11 songs with views and summaries
amended.change: formal scale fixed at all 11 available songs instead of >=12; 5 dev songs and 6 test songs are reported separately
amended.rationale: the 12-song target cannot be met without new candidate collection; the protocol is fixed before any formal dispatch
